_comment: Single source of truth for councilof.ai's ruled public invariants. The drift-guard asserts the LIVE site matches these. When a ruling changes a value (e.g. public_count moves), change it HERE in one place and the guard follows. Do not hand-edit the live site to a value that contradicts this file. Cite live GET /api/gspc for scores.
ruling: LIVE · 2026-10-30 · AXIS-COUNT GRAMMAR (floors, not a frozen number). The board grew 23 → 33 slots on 2026-10-16 (the 10 subject axes) while this file still froze 23/23/0, so drift-guard went red on a CORRECT live board and its self-heal re-triggered a deploy every 30 minutes for a number no deploy could change. The counts are now FLOORS plus a GRAMMAR, the same rule scripts/board-production-anchor.mjs already enforced at PR time: GROWTH IS PUBLISHED, SHRINKAGE IS DRIFT. Floors: 33 slots (2026-10-30 live), 23 measured (2026-10-30 live). Prior frozen ruling: 2026-09-22 ADR-002 (23·23·0), superseded by the data, not by copy.
ruling_ref: council-os/ADR-001-axis-count.md (what MEASURED means) · council-os/ADR-002-axis-23-effect-binding.md (the last slot-count ruling) · scripts/board-production-anchor.mjs (the PR-time gate that already encoded this grammar)

api._comment: These are the guard's EXPECTED values, not a surface. A guard has to name the number it is checking for — that is what makes drift detectable — so this is the one place in the estate where an axis count is written down, and every rendered surface derives from the endpoint instead. Read off the signed board, not typed from memory: see _provenance.
api._provenance: Ruled 2026-10-30 (axis-count grammar). FLOORS read off live GET /api/gspc on 2026-10-30: {axes:33, measured_axes:23, unmeasured_axes:10, quotable_axes:23, public_count:'33 axes · 23 measured'}. These are FLOORS, not targets: the live board may GROW above them (a new declared slot is published, not hidden) and the guard stays green. It goes red only if the live board SHRINKS below a floor, or if the live unmeasured count stops equalling axes minus measured, or if the public count line stops agreeing with the live numbers. Previously frozen exact values, each correct at its time and superseded by the data: 2026-09-22 ADR-002 (23·23·0); 2026-09-16 ADR-002 (23·22·1); 2026-09-01 ADR-001 (22·22·0); 2026-08-26 ADR-001 sweep (22·15·7). Earlier states: 14/14/14, then 22/15/7. NOTE: own council-specialist models are excluded from the PUBLIC per-axis leaders (a neutral measurement body does not rank its own models); that exclusion changes leader attribution and separation/mean stats, NOT measured_axes.

count_grammar._rule: axes_total_floor and measured_axes_floor are FLOORS. Growth above a floor is PUBLISHED, not drift — a new declared slot becomes visible on the board and the guard stays green. Shrinkage below a floor IS drift: a slot or a measurement disappeared.
count_grammar.axes_total_floor: The board may not carry FEWER slots than this. It may carry more.
count_grammar.measured_axes_floor: The board may not carry FEWER measured axes than this — a measurement disappearing is drift. It may carry more.
count_grammar.unmeasured_derives_from_data: totals.unmeasured_axes MUST equal totals.axes minus totals.measured_axes, read from the live payload. The number of published gaps is never typed here; it is derived, and the estate's own count_grammar says a published slot is not a measurement.
count_grammar.public_count_agrees_with_data: totals.public_count MUST equal the line composed from the SAME live numbers ('<axes> axes · <measured> measured'). Public copy must agree with the data beside it; a copy that keeps a frozen number while the data moves is the drift this block exists to catch.
count_grammar.why_not_a_frozen_number: A pin on a count the estate can legitimately grow is a guard that cries wolf. This guard was red for 114 consecutive runs on a correct live board, and its self-heal re-triggered a deploy every 30 minutes for roughly 50 days — to fix a number a deploy cannot change. A gate red on a correct answer gets set to continue-on-error within a week, and then it protects nothing: the same end state as a gate that cannot go red at all.

api._grammar: axes_total counts SLOTS; measured_axes counts slots with a real run behind them; unmeasured_axes is published so the gap is visible, and is DERIVED from the other two rather than ruled. A slot on the board is NOT a measurement. The two counts must travel together in public copy so the grammar stays honest as slots are added with no run behind them.
